title: AIFP Canonical Subject Reference v1
description: The canonical string of a subject reference is <scheme>:<domain>:<identifier>; subjectRef = keccak256(utf8(canonical)). Scheme and domain never contain ':', so the string parses left to right. Addresses are lowercase hex, integers are decimal without leading zeros. An address is never left-padded into bytes32: there is exactly one encoding.

oneOf.title: did
oneOf.description: did:<method>:<method-specific-id as given, case preserved>; the canonical string equals the DID
